annotation.kind: equation (2.3) with explicit paper-local two-precision execution model

conditions.L: Identical fixed statement and P63 shared files plus frozen NumStability library.
conditions.N: Identical fixed statement and P63 shared files; no NumStability artifact.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p63_t1_two_precision_residual (fpHi fpLo : P63FPModel) (n : ℕ) ... : ∀ i, componentwise two-precision residual error bound
formal_statement.plain_language: Each component of the stored residual differs from the exact residual by at most the working-precision rounding of that exact component plus the amplified high-precision residual error.

informal_proof: The paper bounds the high-precision residual calculation, bounds its rounding to working precision, and combines the two stage errors.
informal_statement: The computed two-precision iterative-refinement residual obeys the componentwise error bound in equation (2.3).
paper_version: published SISC version; 2017, volume 39 issue 6, pages A2834-A2856

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: Both exact private proofs compile without sorry/admit; N imports no NumStability.

source_locations.anchor: Algorithm 1.1, residual computed in high precision and stored in working precision

tier_rationale: The exact L proof invokes one substantial frozen theorem, NumStability.conventional_residual_error, for the high-precision residual stage. The N proof reconstructs the rounded dot-product and residual analyses independently. The final storage-rounding step is simple algebra, and Mathlib has no ready floating-point residual theorem. N is over 700 lines; L is under 100.
